description: The public slot-status signal (scripts/slot_status.py). The primary's local_heartbeat start/finish publish one small document per trading day (day, market open or closed, each slot's status and time; never tickers, amounts, accounts or orders) to a data-only branch, and each Perplexity backup reads it first: a slot marked succeeded today, or a closed market, ends the fire before any other call. Anything else falls through to the full check. The branch must not be recommendations (the publisher force-pushes a one-file tree), main or claude/** (CI).
